subject: Redwood x Aceros — Pilot scope, metrics & access next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@aceros.com>, Tom Hsu <thsu@aceros.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x Aceros — quick post-demo recap and next steps

Thanks again for your time today — quick note to capture what we heard and propose a concrete kickoff plan. High level takeaways from the demo and discovery: 

- Pain: Full-text search + entity extraction on maintenance logs is noisy today; engineers spend ~2–3 hrs/week triaging false positives.
- Goal: Reduce false positives by 40% on top 3 failure modes and return structured incident summaries (component, severity, suggested remedial steps).
- Volume: ~120k raw log lines/month, median document length ~350 tokens.
- Constraints: Sensitive PII in some free-text fields; strict data retention policy (90 days) and SOC 2 evidence required.

Proposed pilot scope (30 days):
1) Ingest a 30-day slice (anonymized) into a dedicated Redwood Private instance.
2) Run prompt suite for extraction + classification (we will provide an initial prompt set).
3) Success metrics: 40% reduction in false positives (baseline TBD), 85% precision on severity labels, 200ms median inference latency for single-document calls.
4) Owners: Aceros — Jenna (product lead), Tom (infra); Redwood — Sergio (sales lead), Karthik (SRE/SE), Monica (CS/enablement).

Access & setup asks (what we need to kick off):
- S3 access or secure file share with a sample 30-day extract (anonymized).
- List of fields with PII markers and any existing redaction rules.
- SOC 2 questionnaire contact or attested report (Jenna noted security will share).
- A short Slack channel or weekly 30-min cadence for engineering syncs.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf (stub), access spreadsheet template (aceros_mup_maestro_access_sheet.xlsx).

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 9/16: handoff call with Aceros infra + security (30 min).
- Mon 9/20: data ingestion & environment provisioned.
- Week of 9/27: run first eval + share preliminary results.

Could you confirm owners + availability for the 9/16 handoff? Also if security wants to run through the SOC-2 checklist first, we can bring our compliance engineer onto the call.

Thanks,
Sergio

Thanks Sergio — this is great and captures what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Security: copied our security mailbox; they will send over the SOC 2 snapshot and a short onboarding checklist. Expect that later today.

Appreciate it — Jenna

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Security (Aceros) <security@aceros.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood x Aceros — handoff + pilot kickoff plan (details)

Thanks Jenna — confirmed for 09:30 PT tomorrow (9/16). Below is a slightly expanded kickoff packet so everyone can come prepared.

1) Definitions and success gates
- Baseline: we will compute baseline FP rate from the rule-based extractor you currently run (please include sample outputs).
- Primary metric: Relative reduction in false positives on the top-3 failure modes (target >=40%).
- Secondary metric: Severity label precision >=85%, and human review time reduced by 30% on triage tasks.

2) Pilot components
- Data ingestion: S3 read-only account (preferred) OR rsync endpoint (we can accept both).
- Infra: Redwood will spin up a dedicated Private tenant in us-west-2 for the pilot (isolated, access-controlled).
- Prompt & eval: Redwood will supply an initial prompt set + eval harness; Aceros will provide labeled examples for tuning (5–10 per failure mode to start).

3) Owners & immediate asks
- Aceros: Jenna (product owner), Tom (infra + credentials), Security (SOC2 packet).
- Redwood: Sergio (engagement lead), Karthik (SE — will do environment provisioning), Monica (CS — onboarding and prompt workshops).
- Immediate asks before 9/20 provisioning: sample data (S3 link or rsync), list of PII fields, and any retention rules that would affect export.

4) Timeline (refined)
- 9/16 09:30 PT: Handoff w/ infra + security (30 min) — Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
- 9/20: Environment provisioned and first ingestion run
- 9/27: First eval results and triage session
- 10/08: Pilot wrap — decision meeting (continue/scale/stop)

5) Prompt set & eval plan (short)
- We will deliver a starter prompt pack (extraction, severity mapping, summary template) and a small eval harness that computes precision/recall on labeled examples.

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan.pdf (signed MUP skeleton), aceros_mup_maestro_access_sheet.xlsx (please fill S3 details section).

If everyone is aligned I'll send a DocuSign MUP stub and a HubSpot engagement record with the deals owner.

Best,
Sergio
